title: Axios reports expected RNC midterm funding deployment
summary: Attributed reporting only:Axios says James Blair told Senate Republicans to expect RNC and MAGA Inc. money to enter midterm races, without specifying timing or destinations.

sources.title: Scoop:Trump team tells GOP to lean in on health care

data.claim: Axios reported that James Blair told Senate Republicans to expect Republican National Committee and MAGA Inc. money to start flowing into midterm races, without specifying when or where.
